title: Star seekers
creator_credit: John Wilson, Sterling Educational Films and Fine Arts
brief_description: This film gives a rather brief and superficial account of man’s view of the universe. The Greek explanations in terms of the elements are discussed, as are the contributions and theories of Pythagoras, Ptolemy, Copernicus, Kepler, Newton and Kant. Also introduces the theories of Einstein and Hoyle.
